title: Stability in stochastic hypergraph matching III: general reneging
summary: In many real-life matching problems, waiting agents might abandon before being matched, such as patients deceasing before receiving organs, passengers/drivers cancelling ride requests, or raw materials/intermediary products degrading in production lines. This poses the need for incorporating reneging in stochastic matching models. In this work, we consider matching models on hypergraphs with batch arrivals and general-weight matchings.
